source: X3 of the upgrade work order; rebuilt from docs/capability-matrix.md, docs/routing-contract.md, the SKILL.md files and the work order's item list (the plan's 33-row map, section 3.4.1, could not be read in the implementing session)

capabilities.capability: Measurement design and verdict-first review: estimand, selections and cutflows, backgrounds, correction chains, systematics plan, blinding policy
Cosmic-ray flux from counts and its helpers (orbit cutoff, force field, broken power law, anisotropy design)
Scaling class of systematics (statistical-like, floor, mixed) and uncertainty projection
Collection time per period with quality cuts, cutoff transmission and eras
Spectral-variable transformation with an isotope-composition model (Jacobian, bin averaging)
Acceptance from generation records
Response objects, forward folding, double-counting checks
Resolution and efficiency at detector level (tag-and-probe, truth matching, weighted efficiency)
Fast spectrometer simulation (layers, field model, charge and velocity estimators, eras)
Propagating a calibration residual (scale, inverse offset, resolution) to yields, ratios and covariance
Response construction from matched truth and reconstructed events
Charge-sign confusion, nuclear interactions in material and species-migration responses
Multi-sample particle identification (charge from many samples, likelihood ratios)
Stability monitoring over time (trends, change points, era boundaries)
Detector design principles and a sourced detector atlas
Geomagnetic backtracing with an external tracer
Full detector simulation with Geant4: reproducible runs, implementation checks, convergence gate, independent-reference benchmarks
Likelihoods, binned and unbinned fits, template fits, intervals and limits, significance and look-elsewhere effects
Covariance assembly and validation, combinations, comparisons with published records
Unfolding with regularization and coverage
Bayesian posteriors, priors, samplers and convergence diagnostics
Binned time-series inference and periodicity
Consistency of split samples and multi-era joint fits
RooFit/RooStats fit-status mapping and cross-checks
Conventions, derivations, cross sections, decay rates, higher-order and PDF uncertainties, predictions for published data
Recasting a published analysis with a parametrized response
Physical constants and particle and nuclear data with source and edition
Relativistic kinematics: two-body decays, boosts, invariant mass, Mandelstam variables, thresholds
capabilities.note: core/kinematics/relativistic.py has point and bin-edge conversions only

capabilities.capability: Cosmic-ray propagation models, narrow secondary-ratio and antiproton predictions, solar modulation; codes, cross-section nuisances, global-fit structure and new-physics interpretation guidance
Nuclear cross-section conventions, nuclear decays and Q-values
Local partition, batch campaigns, resubmission and duplicate-safe merges
ROOT, PyROOT, uproot/awkward and columnar data tools
Environment manifests, run records, workflows and preservation
Implementation-ready research tasks for coding agents
Grouped splits, training, inference domain flags, calibration and ML artifacts
BDT pipeline for analyses (cross-training, negative weights, working points)
Era changes in machine-learning studies
Literature and citation verification, read levels, literature records, planned claims to recheck
Claims linked to results, manuscript checks, citations checked against literature records
Terminology and notation against a glossary
Paper types, venues, numbers from artifacts and spectrum plots
Lattice QCD and its global analyses
EFT global fits
CKM global fits
Global cosmic-ray propagation fits that run a propagation code
Interpreting an excess with a dark-matter model (which model explains a signal)
capabilities.note: stays limited-support after Th5: conventions are in v1, the choice of a model that explains an excess is not

capabilities.capability: Heavy-ion physics (quark-gluon plasma, collective flow)
Nuclear-structure calculations (shell model, density functionals)
Full relic-density Boltzmann solvers
Model calculations of PDFs, TMDs and GPDs (quark models, chiral quark soliton, AdS/QCD)
capabilities.note: results may be cited inputs with source and status, as alternative-model objects

capabilities.capability: Quarkonium production and absorption (NRQCD, J/psi in pA and eA)
capabilities.note: only its distinction from Drell-Yan is stated

capabilities.capability: Jets and jet substructure in lepton-hadron scattering, resolved-photon photoproduction
capabilities.note: jet-algorithm conventions and selections go to hep-measurement

capabilities.capability: Neutrino-oscillation probabilities, including matter effects
capabilities.note: in v1 since Th4 (batch C): three flavours, vacuum and constant density; global fits of the parameters stay outside v1

capabilities.capability: Dark-matter phenomenology conventions: spin-independent recoil rates in the standard halo model, form factors, J and D factors, flux prefactors, relic-density conventions (no Boltzmann solver)
capabilities.note: in v1 since Th5 (batch D); halo and cross-section inputs from the user

capabilities.capability: Unpolarized inclusive DIS structure functions and cross sections (LO from user-supplied parton values, sum-rule integrals; beyond LO as rules)
Drell-Yan cross sections (LO, photon exchange), x_F and rapidity-frame conversions, angular coefficients and frames, Lam-Tung combination
Nuclear targets: per-nucleon conventions, isospin combination, nuclear PDF sets and baselines, member-by-member nuclear ratios; mechanism models as rules
Polarized DIS: g_1, g_2, asymmetries and depolarization factors, first-moment sum rules, factorization-scheme dependence of Delta Sigma
SIDIS kinematics and Trento conventions, fragmentation functions, TMD factorization rules, Gaussian-ansatz TMD shapes, Sivers sign change, Drell-Yan q_T
Small-x physics: dipole picture with LO photon wave functions, GBW saturation model, BK/JIMWLK and BFKL conventions as rules
Exclusive processes and GPDs (DVCS kinematics, azimuthal conventions, GPD properties and sum rules) and diffractive DIS kinematics; GPD extraction outside the tool
